historical_references.reference: Al-Muzaffar Ahmad Sanjar founded the Ghaznavid Empire in 977 CE and named the new capital Almaz, meaning 'gem' or 'jewel', due to its rich resources and strategic location.
historical_references.context: Founding of the Ghaznavid Empire and establishment of Almaz as its capital city

historical_references.reference: The Mongol prince Hulagu Khan conquered Almaz in 1262 CE during his campaign against the Khwarazmian Empire. The city was later renamed Marghad and remained an important trading center in Central Asia.
historical_references.context: Conquest of Almaz by Hulagu Khan and subsequent renaming as Marghad
